summary: Senior Manager, Investment Oversight candidate bringing ~7 years across institutional investment analytics, portfolio risk attribution, and independent review of multi-asset mandates. Holds delegated sign-off authority at Moody's Analytics on valuation, sensitivity, and portfolio outputs for mandates of $5-25bn per engagement, and contributes to methodology and documentation standards as a member of the model governance committee. Delivered VaR/CVaR optimization, asset allocation and LDI analysis at Ortec Finance, presenting findings to pension investment committees. CFA charterholder; dual MSc.

roles.title: Asst. Director - Modelling Services (Investment & ALM Risk Lead)

sections.heading: Investment Oversight & Independent Review
bullets: Hold delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and portfolio outputs delivered to multi-asset institutional mandates of $5-25bn per engagement (~$50bn+ cumulative), independently reviewing curve construction, spread calibration, and cross-asset interactions before production release.
Serve on the model governance committee, contributing to methodology review, documentation and benchmarking standards, and model-performance assessment for client-delivered investment analytics.
Escalate outputs lacking mathematical or economic defensibility and act as escalation point for client-critical analytical issues with clients' Heads of Risk and investment stakeholders.

sections.heading: Valuation, Sensitivity & Portfolio Risk Analysis
bullets: Validate derivatives pricing outputs across rates, FX, and inflation, cross-checking sensitivity consistency at portfolio-level aggregates.
Review aggregation logic converting security-level exposures into portfolio-level risk metrics that feed downstream reporting processes.
Oversee interest-rate and duration analysis under parallel and non-parallel rate shocks across multi-asset portfolios, quantifying sensitivity of positions to curve movements.

sections.heading: Committee Reporting & Analytics Delivery
bullets: Prepare analytical summaries for senior stakeholders on rate exposure, scenario impacts, and balance-sheet sensitivities, translating quantitative output into investment-committee-ready narratives.

Led design and implementation of an enterprise multi-asset cash flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios, with configurable time-bucketed gap analytics from T+1 to multi-year horizons.

Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into auditable Python analytics pipelines with embedded logging and validation, and built agentic AI workflows (Claude Code, Cursor) cutting development cycle time an estimated 30-40%.

Led onboarding and implementation for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms migrating to the PFaroe DB (risk & ALM analytics) and PFaroe PM (portfolio management) platforms.

Served as technical liaison between client investment teams and product owners, advising on asset, liability, and portfolio configurations, validating model outputs post-deployment, and migrating all assigned accounts off the legacy Calypso platform.

roles.title: Senior Consultant - IFRS & Financial Risk Transformation

bullets: Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 transformation projects for Canadian and international insurance clients, aligning regulatory requirements with system implementation and financial-reporting frameworks.
Advised actuarial, finance, IT, and program-management functions and contributed to governance documentation and regulatory-readiness processes.

Performed asset-only and asset-liability (surplus) portfolio optimization on VaR and CVaR using Ortec's GLASS platform, with risk decomposition and attribution, contribution-to-risk budgeting, and near-optimal frontier analysis to test the robustness of allocation recommendations.

Advised Canadian and international pension funds and institutional investors on Strategic Asset Allocation (SAA) and Tactical Asset Allocation (TAA) trade-offs through stress testing and sensitivity analysis.
Presented investment analysis and study findings on-site to investment committees at Canadian pension-fund clients.
Built and interpreted stochastic economic scenario generators assessing interest-rate risk and funding volatility under base-case and stressed environments.
Conducted liability-driven investment (LDI) analysis covering trade-offs between return objectives, duration alignment, and liquidity, alongside inflation and currency hedging analysis.

Led onboarding and the study for a three-plan university pension merger on a team of three, developing and validating the model capturing Funding Policy dynamics and evaluating duration, currency, inflation, and leverage overlay strategies.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) - Western University, 2016
